title: Odd weight partial sum check
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let the seed be either a Boolean or an index $k<m$, let $w$ assign Booleans to the $m+2$ input positions, and let $p$ assign Booleans to the $m+1$ proof positions. If the seed is false, then $p_0=w_0+w_1$ in $[1m\mathbb{F}_2[0m$. If the seed is true, then the last proof bit is $1$ in $[1m\mathbb{F}_2[0m$. If the seed is $k$, then $p_{k+1}=p_k+w_{k+2}$ in $[1m\mathbb{F}_2[0m$.
hypotheses_covered: A seed that is either a Boolean or an index $k<m$
An input Boolean string of length $m+2$
A proof Boolean string of length $m+1$
